description: Check that an on-call rota covers a period with no gap. Coverage is the union of the shifts in a rotation, so a gap is reported only where no shift covers the moment at all, which no per-shift check can find. Also reports one person on two rotations at once, where a page to both reaches one person so the second rotation is not a second responder; a shift longer than a stated maximum; too little rest between shifts; and a time with no UTC offset, which leaves a gap at every handover. Pay 150000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

cover_from.description: When coverage must begin. An RFC 3339 timestamp or an epoch number in milliseconds. A string with no UTC offset is reported, because it is not a point in time.

cover_to.description: When coverage must end. An RFC 3339 timestamp or an epoch number in milliseconds. A string with no UTC offset is reported, because it is not a point in time.

max_shift_hours.description: The longest a single shift may be.

min_rest_hours.description: The least time a person may have between shifts.

shifts.description: The shifts. Each rotation is assessed for coverage separately.

end.description: When the shift ends. An RFC 3339 timestamp or an epoch number in milliseconds. A string with no UTC offset is reported, because it is not a point in time.

start.description: When the shift begins. An RFC 3339 timestamp or an epoch number in milliseconds. A string with no UTC offset is reported, because it is not a point in time.

name: on_call_coverage_audit

checked.description: The limits applied, so a limit the caller did not supply is visible as not applied rather than as met.

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

covered.description: True only when every rotation covers the whole period and every limit the caller supplied holds.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

rotations.description: Per rotation: shift count, uncovered minutes, overlapping minutes and how many people appear.

title: On-Call Coverage Audit
